## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior change.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks that were actually run.

## Compatibility and privacy

- [ ] Existing CLI flags and report output remain compatible, or the change is documented.
- [ ] No raw session history, prompts, credentials, tokens, or absolute local paths are included.
- [ ] Privacy, Judge transmission, and cache-format effects are documented where applicable.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
